info.title: API.SH: BusinessesForSale
info.description: The BusinessesForSale API from API.SH: public BusinessesForSale data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

A business broker's listings on BusinessesForSale.com: broker id and name, total and each listing (as in search), with sort and paging. Give the broker page link (broker.url of a listing) or the broker id.

get.description:
Franchise opportunities listed on BusinessesForSale.com for the US, UK or Canada, all or one category: name, link, labels, franchise or license fee, total investment, liquid capital, lifestyle, management, summary and logo, with the total count. 20 a page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/businessesforsale-franchises

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug as in the site's franchise links (food, fast-food, cafe-and-coffee, home-services, cleaning, care, education, automotive, business-services, low-cost, ...) or a /franchises/search/<category>-franchise-opportunities link. Leave it out for all.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One business for sale on BusinessesForSale.com: id, title, status (new, quick sale...), city, region, country, asking price, sales revenue, cash flow, real estate, full description, every detail the listing gives (premises, size, employees, years established, expansion potential, competition, reasons for selling, trading hours, support and training, financing, home based, relocatable...) grouped by section, photos, related searches and the business broker (name, licence number, broker page and number of listings). A private seller's identity is never shown; `seller_type` says which. Give a listing link as `url`, or `latest=true` with the search params to open the first current business.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/businessesforsale-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A businessesforsale.com listing link (url of a search result).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: run the search with the other params and open its first current business.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Businesses and franchises for sale on BusinessesForSale.com, worldwide or in the US, UK, Canada or Mexico, with the site's filters: sector, region, keywords, asking price, revenue, cash flow (profit), disclosed figures only, listing tags (real property, lease, franchise resale, owner financed, price reduced, distressed, relocatable, work from home...), age of the listing, plus sort and page size. Each result has id, kind (business or franchise), link, title, location, labels, asking price, revenue and cash flow (numbers and the site's text, ranges included), franchise fee and investment for franchises, summary, thumbnail and tags. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/businessesforsale-search

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: Region id within the chosen country market (as in applied_filters.region_ids, e.g. 1007401 = California with country=us).

parameters.name: price_disclosed
parameters.description: Only listings that show an asking price.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Listing tags, comma list: real_property, lease, new_lease, existing_lease, relocatable, work_from_home, accommodation_included, franchise, new_franchise, franchise_resale, business_opportunity, price_reduced, mid_market, distressed, turnaround, bankruptcy, closed_asset_sale, low_cost, owner_financed, hidden_gem, quick_sale, owner_managed, employee_owned, absentee_ownership.

parameters.name: added_within_days
parameters.description: Listed or updated in the last 3, 14, 30 or 90 days.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The sector tree of BusinessesForSale.com with the number of listings in each: top-level sectors, or the sub-sectors of `parent_id` (give two ids, parent,child, for the third level). Use the ids as `sector_id` in /businessesforsale/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/businessesforsale-sectors

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: Optional sector id (or parent,child ids) whose sub-sectors to list.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
